description: ADAMS Public Documents is the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission's public library of agency records, searched through the cloud-based ADAMS Public Search. The Publicly Available Records System Library contains more than 3 million full-text documents that the NRC has released since 1 November 1999, with several hundred added each day, and the public legacy library holds more than 2 million bibliographic citations, some with abstracts and full text, mostly from 1980 onward. The agency digitised over 1 million legacy documents between July 2019 and December 2020. Access: free and open without registration, documents are delivered as PDF, and the page also lists system notices, hours of operation, help pages and an FAQ; no licence is stated. Coverage is US nuclear regulation, including licensing, inspection and event documents. Caveats: the page describes the system but does not document a bulk download route, and only the description page was read here. It suits emergency response and resilience studies that need primary regulatory evidence on nuclear plant events, and it relates to the NRC event notification reports record catalogued here as data-nrc-event-notification-reports.
